highlights: On Windows, do not uninstall OpenBot from Windows Settings to fix a failed update, because that can delete your agent folders. Install this version instead.
On Windows, updates work again when OpenBot was installed in the folder that holds your agents. Your agents, Shared and Downloads stay where they are.
If the taskbar pin no longer opens OpenBot after this update, pin it again from the Start menu.
The Windows installer no longer lets you choose the folder that holds your agents or your user data.
